summary: The iterative implementation handles very large literals, and the focused suite plus additional large space-only, escaped-quote, and Unicode cases pass. However, it changes the existing transformation for inputs with an unmatched quote suffix, contrary to the requirement to preserve existing behavior.

findings.claim: Unconditionally consuming doubled quotes loses the original regex fallback when no later closing quote exists. For input "'a  ''", the original implementation recognizes the first pair and returns "'a''", whereas this implementation leaves the spaces intact. This also changes complete SQL containing such text in a double-quoted identifier (SELECT "'a  ''" FROM t); the task explicitly retains recognition of single quotes inside double quotes. Preserve the original recognition behavior when the escaped-pair interpretation would leave the literal unterminated.
